newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SACCHI'S FIRST DEFEAT LEAVES JUVENTUS SIX POINTS CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SACCHI'S FIRST DEFEAT LEAVES JUVENTUS SIX POINTS CLEAR.

text.p: Former Italy coach Arrigo Sacchi suffered his first league defeat since returning to AC Milan as they went down 1-0 at home on Sunday through Mario Stanic's first-half header for Parma at the San Siro.
The champions' fifth defeat of the season leaves them languishing seventh in the table and was compounded by defender Alessandro Costacurta's second dismissal in two matches.

With second-place Vicenza falling to two Vincenzo Montella goals at Sampdoria and Inter held 1-1 at bottom-of-the-table Reggiana, league leaders Juventus stretched their advantage to six points despite being held 1-1 at Piacenza.

The European champions, who had midfielder Alessio Tacchinardi sent-off, led through an own-goal from Settimio Lucci until five minutes from time when Daniele Delli Carri's equaliser halted their run of four successive league wins.
Juventus now have 29 points from 14 matches, six ahead of Vicenza and Napoli, who beat Lazio 1-0 with a last minute goal from Brazilian Andre Cruz.
